purpose: Provenance registry for 3D assets generated for the MUSE-UM pavilion. A generated asset is an environmental prop: it never replaces a framed exhibit PNG, and it never changes a room's evidenceStatus.

generator.pipeline: Text to 3D, two stages (preview geometry, then refine texture)
generator.note: Generator task IDs are recorded so the exact lineage of every accepted artifact is checkable.

curationGate: A task reaching SUCCEEDED is not acceptance.
Every artifact is reviewed as a rendered image before download.
An artifact is accepted only against its own tiered criteria in assets/meshy/<asset>.json.
Rejected artifacts are logged with the defect that failed them, not silently regenerated.

assets.role: environmental prop standing on the Observatory floor

inspection.optimization: gltf-transform optimize — meshoptimizer simplify, quantization, textures resized to 1024 and converted to webp. Lossy: the delivered mesh is not vertex-identical to the generated one.

acceptedProperties: Four rings crossing on different axes in open space, with no drum, cage or struts between them.
Central sphere present; silhouette reads as a celestial measuring instrument.
Warm aged brass with patina and wear; dark stone base.
Base is plain and unmarked — no lettering, numerals, plaque or inscription anywhere.
knownLimitations: The generated brass reads semi-gloss. The pavilion applies a higher roughness and a locally rendered environment in-engine rather than regenerating for finish.
Engraved star marks did not survive as clearly as the graduation tick marks on the outer band.
assets.reviewNote: Five generated passes were rejected before acceptance: two for invented pseudo-inscriptions that turned out to be geometry rather than texture, one for condensing the four rings into a concentric drum cage, and two superseded refinements. All are logged in the asset spec's reviewLog.

evidenceStatus.note: The armillary is the pavilion's own interpretation of the recorded observatory motif. Its source attachment lives on the Observatory room, not on this prop. The prop asserts nothing about a physical town artifact.

invariants: Every displayed model is listed here with its generator tasks.
Canonical characters are never generated. Luma's body remains fixed by art/luma-canon.json.
A generated prop carries artistic-interpretation status and never upgrades a room's evidence status.
Lossy optimization is disclosed; the delivered mesh is not presented as the generator's raw output.
